A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SUA research. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and can be matched despite the revised title and appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original attack experiments on MLLMU-Bench and CLEAR, including model comparisons, defense evaluations, ablations, sensitivity studies, and case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds a textual, visual, and joint attack comparison in Appendix A.6 and Table 8.

M1.justification: Appendix A.6 adds SUA+, a limited extension combining SUA's image perturbation with GCG-optimized prompt tokens. Text tokens are updated once per five image-noise updates. The original white-box and grey-box SUA procedures remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same fictional-profile datasets, MLLMU-Bench and CLEAR, using blank-filling and question-answering tasks. The new modality comparison evaluates additional attack variants on existing MLLMU-Bench coverage.

E2.justification: Table 8 adds an evaluated GCG-based textual attack as a comparator to SUA and SUA+. The random-noise, paraphrasing, sampling, and FigStep comparisons in Tables 1–7 are retained.

E3.justification: The stated factuality range changes from 0–5 to 0–4 in Section 5.1 and from 1–4 to 0–4 in the appendix prompt, matching the rubric already present in v1. This corrects the reported scoring protocol; the PDFs do not establish rescoring. Existing dataset splits and model settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix A.6 compares textual-only, visual-only, and joint attacks to examine modality contributions and complementarity. Existing alignment-loss ablations, defense evaluations, hyperparameter and training-size studies, retain-set analysis, and case studies are retained.

E5.justification: Existing uncertainty displays, including standard-deviation bars in Figures 4 and 6, are retained. No new run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests are reported; Table 8 supplies point estimates.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 and existing plotted results are unchanged. New Table 8 reports accuracy/factuality of 7.17%/0.97 for the textual attack and 21.33%/2.20 for SUA+, alongside SUA's retained 20.67%/2.05. These are added method comparisons, not improved scores for the original SUA.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, stated threat-model assumptions, loss equations, and zeroth-order gradient estimator are unchanged. The SUA+ extension introduces no new theorem, proof, or formal derivation.

C1.justification: The central claims about recovering hidden knowledge through universal, stealthy perturbations, generalization, and white-box/grey-box effectiveness remain. Although the abstract drops its final sentence about consistent knowledge reappearance, that claim remains in the introduction and conclusion.

C2.justification: Appendix A.6 newly interprets visual inputs as more informative and influential and textual optimization as complementary to SUA. Existing interpretations and Section 7's limitations concerning pure black-box attacks and the absence of a proposed robust unlearning method remain.

D1.justification: The abstract adds an implementation-code repository link. Appendix A.6 documents the new attack's ten appended tokens, GCG optimization, and one textual update per five image updates. The PDFs provide the access pointer but do not establish repository contents or accessibility.

R1.justification: v2 adds two Ren et al. (2025) references concerning LLM unlearning and robustness in Appendix A.1, plus Zou et al. (2023) for GCG. The existing novelty claims and broader research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 retitles the paper, edits the abstract, corrects terminology and grammar, updates author information, and adds acknowledgments. Appendix baselines become a bulleted list, and the new A.6 shifts the case study and evaluation prompt to A.7 and A.8. The overall narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds Table 8, moves captions below Tables 1–6, relocates existing figures, and makes a small graphical revision to Figure 2. Existing experimental plots and case-study images are preserved.

improvement.justification: The added modality comparison provides useful evidence about textual and visual attack contributions. Correcting contradictory factuality ranges and adding implementation access information improve clarity and reproduction guidance. These are limited gains: the established results and core claims remain, and the new SUA+ comparison adds no uncertainty estimates.
